parameters.query: SELECT * FROM public.leads WHERE status IN ('NEW', 'READY_TO_CALL') AND call_attempts < max_attempts AND phone NOT IN (SELECT phone FROM public.do_not_call) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 5;
UPDATE public.leads SET status = 'CALLING', call_status = 'CALLING', call_attempts = call_attempts + 1, last_call_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1;
